detail.title: Inspection detail
detail.deleteConfirm: Delete this inspection? This cannot be undone.

capture.setupSubtitle: Set up batch information before capturing.
capture.modeLiveHint: Real-time detection over a tray of seeds.
capture.modePreciseHint: Hold steady at a fixed distance for lab-grade measurement.

modePicker.subtitle: Pick how you want to capture this batch.
modePicker.liveBody: Continuous detection at 20–30 fps. Best for quick field checks, demos, or browsing across a tray.
modePicker.preciseBody: Accurate to ±0.5 mm with depth-based scale. Use for measurements that go into your QA report.
modePicker.infoSubtitle: Use the mode that matches the device hardware and the confidence needed for the inspection.
modePicker.livePrereqDevice: Supported on iPhone, iPad, and Android devices that can run the camera smoothly.
modePicker.livePrereqCalibration: LiDAR devices lock scale before live view. Other devices need the 5 cm ArUco card visible until calibration locks.
modePicker.livePrereqFrame: Keep the tray flat and the full seed area inside the frame.
modePicker.livePrereqLighting: Use even light and avoid glare while moving across the tray.
modePicker.livePrereqMotion: Move slowly; fast pans reduce count stability.
modePicker.precisePrereqDevice: Best on iPad Pro or iPhone Pro with LiDAR. Non-LiDAR devices use ArUco calibration.
modePicker.precisePrereqCalibration: LiDAR devices lock scale first. Without LiDAR, keep the ArUco card visible until calibration locks.
modePicker.precisePrereqHold: Hold the device steady above the tray before tapping capture.
modePicker.precisePrereqLighting: Use bright, even light and avoid shadows over the tray.
modePicker.precisePrereqUse: Use this mode for final measurements and QA records.

capture.permissionHint: Advance Seeds needs camera access to detect and measure seeds. Grant permission in Settings.
capture.autoTagSubtitle: Save GPS coordinates with each inspection

location.deniedBody: Inspections will save without GPS coordinates. Open Settings to enable location access for Advance Seeds.

recording.tooLargeBody: The video exceeds the {{limitMb}} MB upload limit. Discard?

snapshot.permissionDeniedBody: Advance Seeds needs Photos access to save snapshots. Open Settings to grant it.

calibration.alignMarker: Align the ArUco card to lock calibration
calibration.lockRequiredBody: Keep the 5 cm ArUco card visible until Calibration locked appears, then capture.

processing.subtitle: Detecting seeds, measuring dimensions, and grading quality.
